name: Windz
summary:
Mr. Windz is the strictest teacher in school. Collect all 7 notebooks and solve the math inside. Every wrong answer makes him angrier. Once you have them all, run back to the green exit light.

Watch out: Principal Gale sends runners to detention or the staff room for 20 seconds. Miss Breezy makes you jump rope 5 times (SPACE). Mr. Windz sleeps until you get a question wrong; then he never stops chasing, except while you answer a notebook or pause.
